en: The image shows a rural landscape with fields, a river, and a small village or group of houses. The river flows through a valley with steep hills on the opposite side. There are several buildings, orchards, and cultivated land, suggesting a peaceful countryside scene. The postcard has German text printed in red at the bottom and publisher information in the lower left corner.
